notes.ERI: 18–40 歲的國民都要服兵役或國民役，名義上 18 個月，實際上常無限期延長
notes.ETH: 沒有義務役，但軍方必要時可以徵召
notes.MRT: 有兩年義務役的法律，但據報從未實施
notes.SDN: 法律上男女都要服 12–24 個月；據報實施不一，內戰中政府軍與快速支援部隊都被指控強迫男性與男孩入伍
notes.BLZ: 志願兵不足時才可以徵兵，但從未實施
notes.CRI: 1948 年廢除軍隊，由公安部的警察與準軍事單位負責安全
notes.PAN: 沒有正規軍隊，由國家警察等公共力量負責
notes.RUS: 18–30 歲男性要服 12 個月的義務役
notes.MMR: 男女都要服兵役；2010 年的兵役法 2024 年 2 月起實施，軍政府每年徵召約 6 萬人
notes.KHM: 2006 年的法律要求 18–30 歲服役 18 個月，但從未實施；依 Factbook，政府 2025 年宣布 2026 年起實施、改成 24 個月
notes.CHN: 男女都適用選擇性徵兵，役期 24 個月；解放軍依需要分配各省員額，志願兵不足時地方政府才強制徵召
notes.IDN: 法律准許徵兵，但沒有實施
notes.PRK: 男性 17–30 歲、女性 17–23 歲都要服兵役，男性最長約 10 年、女性約 7 年
notes.KOR: 18–35 歲男性都要服兵役，役期 18–21 個月（依軍種）
notes.SGP: 18–21 歲男性要服 24 個月的義務役
notes.THA: 17 歲男性都要登記，21 歲時抽籤選擇性徵召
notes.TWN: 18–36 歲男性可以志願入伍，或服 12 個月的義務役（2024 年 1 月起，2005 年以後出生的男性從 4 個月恢復為 12 個月）；有些情況可以服替代役；女性可以志願入伍
notes.VNM: 法律上男女都適用，實際上只徵召男性；役期 24–36 個月
notes.DNK: 男女都要服兵役（抽籤決定），役期 11 個月；2025 年 6 月起女性也納入徵兵
notes.DEU: 2011 年起暫停徵兵；2025 年 12 月的兵役改革，2026 年起 18 歲男性要填寫是否願意服役的問卷，女性仍是自願
notes.HRV: 2008 年廢除；依 Factbook（2025 年）的說法，2026 年起 19–29 歲男性要受 2 個月基本軍事訓練
notes.ISL: 沒有正規軍隊，由警察與海岸防衛隊負責
notes.NLD: 全志願役；徵兵制還在法律裡，但 1997 年起暫停
notes.NOR: 19–44 歲的國民（男女）都要接受選擇性徵兵
notes.PRT: 2004 年廢除義務役，但志願兵不足時可以徵召
notes.SWE: 18 歲起男女都要接受選擇性徵兵，役期 9–15 個月
notes.CHE: 18–30 歲男性都要服兵役或替代役（245 天）；女性可以志願
notes.UKR: 男性 25 歲起徵召，役期 18–24 個月
notes.ISR: 18–21 歲男女都要服兵役，士兵最長 36 個月（依性別、婚姻與職務）；猶太人與德魯茲人徵召，基督徒、切爾克斯人、穆斯林可以志願
notes.JOR: 25–29 歲沒有工作的男性 2020 年起要服 12 個月的義務役；依 Factbook（2025 年）的說法，18 歲男性的 3 個月選擇性義務役 2026 年恢復
notes.SYR: 阿薩德政權時期 18–38 歲男性要服役 18–21 個月；政權垮台後過渡政府宣布廢除，只在戰爭等緊急狀況才恢復
notes.MEX: 18 歲男性抽籤決定是否服 12 個月的義務役
notes.USA: 1973 年起全志願役；18–25 歲男性要向選徵兵役局登記，國會立法可以恢復徵兵
notes.ARG: 1995 年起暫停；危機、戰爭或缺員時仍可以徵召
notes.BRA: 18–45 歲男性要服兵役，但只有 5–10% 被徵召的人真的要服役
notes.CHL: 男性選擇性徵兵，但志願兵通常就夠了
notes.PRY: 18–25 歲男性要服至少 12 個月的兵役

notesEn.ERI: Military and national service mandatory for all citizens 18–40; nominally 18 months but often extended indefinitely
notesEn.ETH: No compulsory service, but the military can conduct call-ups when necessary
notesEn.MRT: A two-year compulsory service law reportedly has never been applied
notesEn.SDN: Compulsory for men and women in law, 12–24 months; implementation is reportedly uneven, and both the SAF and RSF are accused of forced recruitment of men and boys during the conflict
notesEn.BLZ: Conscription is allowed only if volunteers are insufficient, but has never been implemented
notesEn.CRI: Abolished its army in 1948; security is handled by police and paramilitary units
notesEn.PAN: No regular military forces; the Public Forces include the National Police
notesEn.GEO: Abolished in 2016 and reinstated in 2017 for men 18–27
notesEn.RUS: Compulsory service for men 18–30; at least 12 months
notesEn.MMR: Compulsory for men and women; the 2010 service law has been enforced since February 2024, with about 60,000 called up a year
notesEn.KHM: A 2006 law requiring 18 months of service for those 18–30 was never enforced; according to the Factbook, the government announced in 2025 that it would be enforced from 2026, with 24 months
notesEn.CHN: Selective compulsory service for men and women, 24 months; the PLA sets provincial quotas, and local governments may compel service only if volunteers fall short
notesEn.IDN: Compulsory service is authorised but not used
notesEn.PRK: Compulsory for men (17–30) and women (17–23); service reportedly up to 10 years for men and 7 for women
notesEn.KOR: Compulsory for all eligible men 18–35; 18–21 months depending on service
notesEn.SGP: Men 18–21 serve 24 months of compulsory service
notesEn.THA: All men register at 17 and are subject to selective (lottery) service at 21
notesEn.TWN: Men 18–36 may volunteer or must serve 12 months (since January 2024, for men born in 2005 or later, up from 4 months); civil service can sometimes be substituted; women may volunteer
notesEn.VNM: Applies to men and women in law, but in practice only men are drafted; 24–36 months
notesEn.DNK: Compulsory for men and women (chosen by lottery); 11 months; conscription was extended to women in June 2025
notesEn.DEU: Conscription ended in 2011; under a December 2025 reform, from 2026 men turning 18 must fill in a questionnaire on their willingness to serve, while it stays voluntary for women
notesEn.HRV: Abolished in 2008; according to the Factbook (2025), from 2026 men 19–29 must undergo two months of basic training
notesEn.ISL: No regular military forces; police and the Coast Guard
notesEn.NLD: All-volunteer; conscription remains in law but has been suspended since 1997
notesEn.NOR: All citizens 19–44, men and women, are subject to selective compulsory service
notesEn.PRT: Compulsory service abolished in 2004, but conscription is possible if volunteers are insufficient
notesEn.SWE: Selective conscription for men and women from 18; 9–15 months
notesEn.CHE: Every man 18–30 must do military or civilian service (245 days); women may volunteer
notesEn.UKR: Conscription for men from age 25; 18–24 months
notesEn.ISR: Compulsory for men and women 18–21, up to 36 months for enlisted personnel (depending on sex, marital status and job); Jews and Druze are conscripted, while Christians, Circassians and Muslims may volunteer
notesEn.JOR: Compulsory service for jobless men 25–29 since 2020; according to the Factbook (2025), 3 months of selective service for men turning 18 resumes in 2026
notesEn.SYR: Under Assad, men 18–38 served 18–21 months; after his fall the interim government abolished it except in emergencies such as war
notesEn.MEX: Men are subject to a lottery for 12 months of compulsory service at 18
notesEn.USA: All-volunteer since 1973; men 18–25 must register with Selective Service, and Congress can reinstate the draft
notesEn.ARG: Suspended in 1995; citizens can still be drafted in a crisis or war, or if vacancies cannot be filled
notesEn.BRA: Compulsory for men 18–45, but only 5–10% of those inducted actually serve
notesEn.CHL: Selective compulsory service for men, but there are usually enough volunteers
notesEn.PRY: All men 18–25 must serve at least 12 months
